instructions: Native macOS notch companion (Swift/SwiftUI/AppKit). Release-blocking: crashes, main-thread/concurrency violations, retain cycles, secret exposure, auth/keychain misuse, entitlement or App Transport Security loosening, missing tests for changed behaviour, and public API breaks. Changes to auth, secrets, CI (.github, scripts/quality), dependencies (Package.swift/Package.resolved), entitlements/Info.plist or public API must never be auto-approved; call them out explicitly for human review. See docs/QUALITY_GATE.md.
